title: Velvety Sweet Dutch Pomegranate Tart
description: A rich and indulgent lacto-vegetarian dessert featuring pomegranate, perfect for a date night, with a malty and crumbly crust, and a velvety sweet filling made with sous-vide cooked pomegranate seeds.
instructions: Sous-vide cook the pomegranate seeds in a water bath at 160 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes to make them tender.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the crust by mixing the flour, malted milk powder, and melted butter in a bowl until a crumbly mixture forms.
Press the crust mixture into a 9 inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake the crust in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
In a blender, puree the cooked pomegranate seeds, granulated sugar, egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Pour the pomegranate puree into the baked tart crust.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for an additional 25 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Allow the tart to cool to room temperature before serving.
